gaps.note: NODE-36 now enforces native-first extraction and OCR-only fallback through KnowledgeExtractionPort. A concrete PDF/DOCX/OCR reader remains an injected Asset/Tool/Sandbox adapter so Agent Runtime does not gain host filesystem or OCR-provider authority.

The canonical Agent-stack uses atomic Git-workspace durable persistence. Scope partitioning occurs before lexical/vector scoring. PostgreSQL FTS/pgvector remains an optional scale backend behind KnowledgeStore rather than a NODE-36 correctness dependency.

KnowledgeEmbeddingPort is provider-neutral and the package imports no provider SDK. Production composition must bind the port to the governed model/capability layer; deterministic embedding remains the offline acceptance implementation.
Freshness fields and stale filtering are implemented. Scheduled re-fetch of external web snapshots is intentionally owned by research/source refresh orchestration.

GitWorkspaceKnowledgeStore persists immutable version manifests, atomically moves an active source head, preserves historical indexes across restart, supports explicit rollback, and never resurrects an old index after current-head deletion.
